summary: Official Philippine Geoportal and Tabaco City sources were reached and inspected. The Lot Plotter lookup endpoints returned HTTP 401 anonymously and no safe parcel ID plus polygon response was qualified.
custodian: City Government of Tabaco (City Assessor/CPDO) is the evidenced local custodian reference; Philippine Geoportal, LMB/DENR, and LRA are national sources. No open local parcel service was verified.
requests: English and Filipino discovery, official portal GETs, current Lot Plotter HTML/JavaScript inspection, bounded endpoint checks, and official Tabaco/LMB references are recorded in the city record. No credentials, unsafe fields, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS disable was used.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
full parcel polygon geometry only when safely returned
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point and population 186310 persons are preserved.
No exact-point hit, unavailable/authenticated route, or UI miss is treated as citywide absence.
No raw source-specific attributes were retained.
uncertainty: Native parcel IDs, CRS, polygons, and coverage remain unverified.
